title: A line holding two approvals, then a reversal
assertion: Each posting share net of the claim it replaced; the reversal `recouped` for the payment it removes: its own claim's approval while the earlier payment stands, every approval when nothing stands, nothing while a later claim stands

files.description: The original payment: 97110 x 2 allowed 70.00 against an expected 100.00 (a case line), CO-45 80.00, PR-2 coinsurance 14.00, paid 56.00.
R2: the original reversed (paid -56.00) and A, allowed 80.00, CO-45 70.00, PR-2 coinsurance 16.00, paid 64.00: BPR02 8.00.
R3: A reversed (paid -64.00) and B, allowed 100.00, CO-45 50.00, PR-2 coinsurance 20.00, paid 80.00: BPR02 16.00.
A posting export with line detail: A’s 64.00 under R2’s trace and B’s 80.00 under R3’s, each the gross payment of its line.
The bank export: 8.00 on R2 and 16.00 on R3.
R4: B reversed alone (paid -80.00) beside another patient's claim paying 150.00: BPR02 70.00.
R3': B' corrects A with no reversal of A, allowed 100.00, CO-45 50.00, PR-2 coinsurance 20.00, paid 80.00: BPR02 80.00 (loaded in place of second.835).
The bank export of that path: 8.00 on R2 and 80.00 on R3'.
R4': B' reversed alone (paid -80.00) beside another patient's claim paying 150.00: BPR02 70.00.
R4'': A reversed alone and late (paid -64.00), while B' stands, beside another patient's claim paying 150.00: BPR02 86.00.

scenario.packet: submitted for the 97110 line before the adjusted remittance arrives

late.note: the 80.00 deposit of R3' proves 16.00, net of the late reversal; no recoupment, and the line is not reopened

onePass.note: adjusted.835 and second.835 loaded, then one reconcile
